subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should WebChat voice become a Gateway/provider-backed core feature now, with TTS using existing `messages.tts`/Gateway TTS and STT using a batch editable `tools.media.audio` path rather than a new `messages.stt` config?
rationale: The missing capability is source-supported, but accepting browser microphone audio and provider-backed playback through the Gateway requires maintainer ownership of privacy, credentials, fallback behavior, and UX scope.

options.title: Split and land provider-backed slices
options.body: Proceed with narrow TTS and STT PRs after security fixes, current-main porting, and redacted real behavior proof.

options.title: Land TTS first, defer STT
options.body: Accept the simpler read-aloud path while keeping batch dictation open until recorder and security policy are settled.

options.title: Defer WebChat voice core work
options.body: Keep browser Talk/media upload workflows as the supported paths until maintainers prioritize a dedicated WebChat voice boundary.

recommendation.title: Split and land provider-backed slices
recommendation.body: Proceed with narrow TTS and STT PRs after security fixes, current-main porting, and redacted real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the prior WebChat dictation implementation and the current TTS read-aloud candidate.
